entities.summary: François-Joseph-Marie Fayolle was a French writer on music, who was born in Paris and is known by his articles in connection with the Biographie Universelle, having furnished the greater portion of the biographies, and by his joint authorship of Choron's Dictionary of Musicians, to which work Fétis was much indebted for information.
